name: OCI Enterprise AI Portal Change Log

entries.summary: Fix hosted UI launch actions and add administration change tracking.
changes: Every hosted deployment UI demo now exposes Launch inside the run window, and UI-only hosted demos use Launch as the only visible action.
The run dialog header is limited to Documentation and OCI wiring diagram links.
Launch-only hosted demos hide prompt, model, project, and temperature fields.
Portal and administration assets include a version query string to avoid stale browser caches.
Administration includes an Object Storage-backed change log view.
Resource Manager apply deployed the hosted application infrastructure and portal runtime metadata.
Portal version shown on the login page was 0.0.17.
